description: JavaScript suspicious code patterns for FiveM NUI resources

rules.name: eval() Dynamic Code Execution
rules.description: Uses eval() to execute dynamic code, a common attack vector in NUI resources.
rules.recommendation: Remove eval() usage. Use safe alternatives.

rules.name: Function Constructor Execution
rules.description: Uses new Function() to execute dynamic code.

rules.name: External Script Loading
rules.description: Dynamically loads external scripts, which can introduce malicious code.
rules.recommendation: Remove dynamic external script loading. All scripts should be local.

rules.name: Obfuscated JavaScript (atob/btoa)
rules.description: Uses atob()/btoa() Base64 functions to encode/decode hidden payloads.
rules.recommendation: Decode and inspect the Base64 content.

rules.name: XMLHttpRequest to External URL
rules.description: Makes an XHR request to an external URL from NUI code.
rules.recommendation: NUI resources should only communicate with the game via PostMessage. External XHR is suspicious.

rules.name: WebSocket Connection to External Host
rules.description: Opens a WebSocket connection to an external host for potential C2 communication.
rules.recommendation: Remove WebSocket connections to external hosts from NUI resources.

rules.name: JavaScript Hex String Encoding
rules.description: Contains hex-encoded strings that may be hiding malicious payloads.
rules.recommendation: Decode and inspect the hex strings.

rules.name: Clipboard Access
rules.description: Accesses the system clipboard, potentially to steal copied tokens or passwords.
rules.recommendation: Review clipboard usage. Remove if not necessary.
